text: Now the good part. The bank doesn't want your house. It wants its money. So call the bank before day ninety. Ask for more time, or a smaller E M I. Start paying on time again... and your score slowly climbs back. One bounced E M I is a bad month. Not a bad life. So next time the phone buzzes... you call them first. Ever got that bounce S M S? Yes or no? Next time: what if India and Pakistan never split? (beat) But that story... is for the next What If.
